page_title: HEI 0-1 RBL | Heidenheim v RB Leipzig 06/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Sascha Stegemann is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
90+2' Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Sascha Stegemann didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

90+1' Yussuf Poulsen almost found himself in a promising position after Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the left post!
85' Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Sascha Stegemann had an easy-decision to make.
83' Fine attempt! Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) is coming onto the pitch as Amadou Haidara cannot continue after picking up an injury.
83' Frank Schmidt has decided to substitute Marvin Pieringer and he is replaced by Maximilian Breunig (Heidenheim).
83' A substitution has been made. Paul Wanner is replaced by Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim).
79' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
76' Here is a change. Xavi Simons is going off and Marco Rose gives the last tactical orders to Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig).
76' Here's the change. Benjamin Sesko leaves the pitch and Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) comes on as a substitute.
73' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) squanders a huge chance from point blank range. His volley is directed towards the right side of the goal, but Peter Gulacsi is alert and makes an amazing save!
72' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) has tested the patience of referee Sascha Stegemann and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
69' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
69' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Arthur Vermeeren as he is replaced by Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig).
69' Marco Rose prepares a substitution. David Raum is replaced by Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig).
68' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar.
67' Frank Schmidt decides to make a substitution. Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen will be replaced by Leo Scienza (Heidenheim).
67' Substitution. Omar Haktab Traore leaves the pitch and is replaced by Adrian Beck (Heidenheim).
67' Frank Schmidt has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) replacing Lennard Maloney.
66' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) attempts to find Jan Schoppner, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
65' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) serves up a nice cross, but Peter Gulacsi punches the ball away.
65' Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle as Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
64' The ball rebounds out to Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
62' A cross into the box picks out Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot high over the bar.
61' A dangerous towering header by Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
60' Heidenheim force a corner. They send men into the box.
59' 0 - 1 Goal! Antonio Nusa shows great vision to find Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
58' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
56' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
54' The goal by RB Leipzig is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a foul.
53' The RB Leipzig players halt their celebrations as referee Sascha Stegemann makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.

52' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) outjumps the defence in the centre of the box and connects with the free kick from David Raum. He sends the ball inside the right post with his towering header and alters the score to 0:1.
51' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul. RB Leipzig are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
50' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
49' The resulting corner, taken by David Raum (RB Leipzig), comes to nothing.

48' David Raum (RB Leipzig) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes out of play. RB Leipzig are awarded a corner kick.
48' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by RB Leipzig, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
47' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) makes a strong challenge and Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul. RB Leipzig will take a free kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
45' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
44' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from RB Leipzig comes to nothing.
43' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the middle of the goal is smartly dealt with by Kevin Muller.
37' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
35' Heidenheim are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
33' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) fires a wonderful strike towards goal, but it's a whisker wide of the left post.
29' David Raum (RB Leipzig) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Kevin Muller, who smothers the ball.
28' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
21' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
18' It's like he was asking for a caution. Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) receives a yellow card.
15' A cross from Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
12' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) plays a lovely through ball to Lois Openda, but he can't beat Kevin Muller and loses the ball.
9' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) jumps into a tackle and Sascha Stegemann signals a foul.
8' Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
6' A player from Heidenheim commits a rough challenge. Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
4' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Lois Openda, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
1' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
1' There's an opportunity for Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and RB Leipzig will have the kick-off.
Sascha Stegemann will referee today's match.
